_note: Townsfolk (docs/civilians_plan.md). Each type walks between the map's pois whose tags it likes, stays a while, then picks the next. nightOut = share that stays out at night (the rest walk home, homeSpeed times their walking speed, and go in). Counts cut 25% 2026-10-17 (Tim); nightOut 0.1 so about 90% go in at night (Tim). Counts raised to 30 for the 2x map 2026-10-18 (plan 0a); homes list the old and the new map's poi ids (ids a map lacks are skipped). reactSeconds = at most one scared / chat reaction per townsperson in that time. Seconds and world units; tune in playtests.

rules._homes: a type's homes are poi ids in front of the buildings it lives in (default: every home poi); townsfolk start there, go in there at night and come out there; by day they walk anywhere they like (Tim 2026-10-18)
